blockers: Champion/spirit proxy is not a validated archetype classifier
No independent second temporal validation period
DIAO bands and published package selection predate this audit but overlap holdout history

method.target: Per-deck event match-point rate: (wins + 0.5 ties) / matches, equal weight per deck entry; not a match-win probability.
method.split: First 70% of distinct UTC event dates train; later dates hold out. No date crosses the boundary.
method.baseline: Smoothed champion, champion/spirit, and player history (20 prior deck entries); weights 0.25/0.5/0.25. Training residuals use leave-one-entry-out means.
method.candidate: Fixed ridge penalty 0.1*n; train-only standardization and mean imputation plus missingness indicators. Predictions clipped to 0.01–0.99. No tuning on holdout.
method.uncertainty: 400 deterministic paired event-cluster bootstrap resamples; improvement is baseline squared error minus candidate squared error. Interval omitted below 20 events.
method.simulations: Existing Tonoris report policy, 128 deterministic samples, turns 3 and 5; these checkpoints are not validated expected game lengths.
